answer: Random peer-review audit blocks sybil farms. Each epoch a beacon picks random auditors, and every identity faces three surprise audits, like a zephyr unforeseen. Applicants wait in a lagoon till cleared. Auditors stake 10 POA: approving a fake forfeits it, catching one earns 5 POA. Each identity posts a 20 POA bond, so 1000 fakes cost 20,000 POA an epoch. An honest agent pays one bond, passes, earns fees. The ivory seal marks three clean epochs.
